# Introduction

This demonstration report summarizes a \gls{PK} analysis of theophylline
concentrations from the built-in `Theoph` dataset [@boeckmann1994],
rendered end to end through quartifyr's two-pass shell/fill pipeline.

{{< pagebreak >}}

{{< appendix "StatisticalMethods" "Statistical Methods" >}}

Per-participant summary statistics were computed directly from the observed
concentration-time data; no model-based estimation (e.g. the nonlinear
mixed-effects approach in [@pinheiro1995]) was performed for this
demonstration report. See {{< appendix_crossref "StatisticalMethods" >}}
for the complete methodology.
